selection: eight lowest SHA256(exact FEN UTF8) per phase, ties exact FEN; no teacher scores or model outputs
replicateOrder: selected order first; reverse order second, reversing each FEN's baseline/candidate ordering inside native paired search
parity: every validation FEN, baseline and integer candidate, all five models, zero mismatches
timingEnvironment: single local native CPU experiment after fitting and OOD labelling finish; no competing experiment workload
statistics: paired geometric mean baseline_ns/candidate_ns and candidate_NPS/baseline_NPS, all observations retained, per-phase breakdown, requested-node completion counts
claims: native development cost only; changed search trees and possible early termination; no Elo, WASM, browser or physical-device claim
repeatPolicy: one complete declared run; no selective rerun after a valid result
